This file helps AI coding agents become productive fast in this repository. Keep instructions concise and concrete — reference files and patterns that actually exist here.

1) Big-picture architecture  
Backend: Express API in `backend/` (entry `backend/index.js`). Routes: `backend/src/routes/`; controllers: `backend/src/controllers/`; repositories: `backend/src/repositories/` with `RepositoryFactory` to switch JSON file vs Mongo. `menus` routes use multer `upload.single("image")`.  
Frontend: React app in `frontend/` (CRA-like). Primary code: `frontend/src/`. Admin UI: `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (e.g., `adminhomes.jsx`). API client: `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, and detects `FormData` (do not set `Content-Type` manually).  
Integration: image storage local filesystem or Cloudinary. Config via `backend/.env` (e.g., `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`).  
JWT auth: frontend relies on saved tokens in browser local storage; API client includes `credentials: 'include'` (always double check this).

2) Read first  
`backend/src/routes/*.js` (look for `upload.single("image")`).  
`backend/src/controllers/*`.  
`backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`.  
`backend/.env.examples`.  
`frontend/src/lib/api.js`:
